g.text: Each row below is one monomial. The cells are its six exponents; the number at right is its exact coefficient.

g.text: All three representatives satisfy the complete E1 condition with checked numerator lifts.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: These pictures describe a polynomial basis; they do not establish E2, coprimality, a certificate, or a geometric phase transition.
